description.value: You form an orb of power, forming it into an element of your choice. Select an element damage type from acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. Make a ranged spell attack against a target you can see within range. On hit, the target takes 3d8 damage of the selected elemental damage type.\n\n

higher_level_description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.
